overview_description.description:
Consolidating Vulnerability Management, Device Hardening, Compliance Enablement, and AI Governance into a single, autonomous engine, Remedio provides a unified zero-surprise, zero-excuse enforcement layer for the entire digital estate.  The platform continuously hardens device posture across endpoints, servers, and cloud environments. By preemptively detecting and remediating risky device settings, compliance violations, policy gaps, configuration drift, and unpatched vulnerabilities, along with shadow IT and AI risks, Remedio helps operators take back control of their estates.

Remedio delivers safe remediation by mapping all operational and software dependencies before applying any changes, so fixes are applied with full awareness of how devices, services, and applications are interconnected. This minimizes risk and ensures that remediations won't break business-critical functions. As an additional safeguard, any remediation action can be instantly rolled back with a single click, restoring the previous state and guaranteeing zero business disruption if an unexpected issue arises.

Designed to fit any device or operating system or computing environment, Remedio simplify complex security and compliance – scalably and sustainably.
